Morphologically {{suffix|en|refer|ence}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛf.(ə.)ɹəns/|[ˈɹɛf.ɹn̩s]|a=RP,GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-reference.ogg|a=California}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-reference.wav|a=Texas}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛf.ə.ɹɛns/|a=obsolete|ref={{R:Critical Pronouncing Dictionary|Reference|449|1|ipage=1}}}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹef.(ə.)ɹəns/|a=AU,NZ}} * {{hyphenation|en|ref|er|ence}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛfəɹəns|s=3}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # {{lb|en|literary|or|archaic}} A [[relationship]] or [[relation]] ({{m|en|to}} something). #* {{RQ:Burton Melancholy|edition=2nd|Charity, compoſed of all three kindes, Pleaſant, Profitable, Honeſt|3|1|3|subsection=1|page=349|url=https://archive.org/stream/2319035R.nlm.nih.gov/2319035R#page/n430|passage=A man is beloued of a man, in that he is a man, but all theſe are farre more eminent and great, when they ſhal proceed from a ſanctified ſpirit, that hath a true touch of Religion, and a '''reference''' to God.}} # A [[measurement]] one can compare (some other measurement) to. # [[information|Information]] about a person, provided by someone (a [[referee]]) with whom they are well acquainted. #* {{quote-book|en|year=a. 1800|author=w:William Cowper|chapter=An Epistle to Joseph Hill, Esq.|title=The Task, Tirocinium, and Other Poems|page=180|pageurl=https://books.google.com/books?id=_3QCAAAAQAAJ&pg=PA180|passage=Changes will befall, and friends may part, / But distance only cannot change the heart / And were I call’d to prove th’ assertion true, / One proof should serve—a '''reference''' to you.}} # {{lb|en|especially|US}} A person who provides this information; a [[referee]]. # {{lb|en|often|attributive}} A [[reference work]]. #: {{uxi|en|'''reference''' grammar|detailed linguistic description of a particular language's grammar}} #: {{uxi|en|'''Reference''' Dictionary of Linguistics}} # The act of referring or [[allude|alluding]] to (a piece of media, historical event, etc). #: {{syn|en|allusion}} #* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:San Francisco Chronicle|title=Original or translated? Great literature takes both forms|date=February 10 2020|author=Barbara Lane|url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/entertainment/books/article/original-or-translated-great-literature-takes-21177692.php |text=Now, I’m no expert on “The Odyssey,” aside from suffering through it in high school. I remember just enough to toss out a '''reference''' to being caught between Scylla and Charybdis, or an analogy to Penelope’s suitors, when I’m eager to make an impression.}} # The act of referring: a submitting for information or decision. # {{lb|en|semantics}} A [[relation]] between objects in which one object [[designate]]s, or acts as a means by which to [[connect]] to or [[link]] to, another object. # {{lb|en|academic writing}} A short written [[identification]] of a previously published work which is used as a [[source]] for a text. # {{lb|en|academic writing}} A previously published [[written]] [[work]] thus indicated; a source. # {{lb|en|computing}} An object containing information which refers to data stored elsewhere, as opposed to containing the data itself. # {{lb|en|programming|character entity}} A special sequence used to represent complex characters in markup languages, such as ™ for the ™ symbol. # {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[appeal|Appeal]]. #* authorities object to the use of {{m|en||reference}} as a verb with a meaning other than “provide a list of references for,” preferring {{m|en|refer|refer to}} or {{m|en|cite}} in these cases. Others allow the meaning “cite [as evidence, an example, etc.]” but reject “mention.”{{R:AHD}} Nevertheless, the proscribed usages are common in both writing and speech. ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|georeferencer|referencer|rereference|cross-reference}} ====Related terms==== * {{l|en|referee}} * {{l|en|referent}} * {{l|en|referential}} * {{l|en|relate}} * {{l|en|relation}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|to refer to}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Estonian: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Japanese: * Māori: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|ссыла́ться}} + {{l|ru|на|g=impf}} * Spanish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to mention}} * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Hindi: * Japanese: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{t+|ru|упомина́ть|impf}} * Spanish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to contain the memory address of another value}} * Finnish: * Russian: {{t+|ru|ссыла́ться}} + {{l|ru|на|g=impf}} {{trans-bottom}} ===References=== {{reflist}} ===Further reading=== * {{R:Webster 1913}} * {{R:Century}} * {{R:OneLook}} {{cln|en|2-syllable words|transitive verbs}}
